title: UserTerritory2AssocLog - Data API
description: Represents a log of when a user is assigned and unassigned from a territory. This object is available in API version 57.0 and later.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: ISO code of currency. Possible values are: EUR—Euro INR—Indian Rupee USD—U.S. Dollar The default value is USD.

EndDate.description: Date when the user is unassigned from a territory. If the end date is empty, the user is still assigned.

Name.description: Auto-generated unique name of the log.

RoleInTerritory2.description: User’s role in the territory between the start and end date. The picklist is, by default, empty. Add values to this field using Object Manager.

StartDate.description: Date the user is assigned to the territory.

Territory2Id.description: ID of the territory associated with the log. This field is a relationship field.

Territory2ModelId.description: ID of the territory model associated with the log. This field is a relationship field.

UserId.description: ID of the user associated with the log. This field is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: To see this object, enable Sales Territory and User Tracking on the Territory Settings page. Activate a territory model to start the tracking.
